items.html: And now, in this third phase, three Mochin were corrected within the Galgalta of ZA, in the secret of KHB. And it was already stated above that the three above-mentioned phases are the three letters of the Tzelem, and they are KHB: the Mem is Hochma, the Lamed is Bina, the Tzadi is Daat. And first came the Hochma, and afterwards the Daat, and afterwards the Bina — they are the three letters of the male Tzelem. Thus the order would be MTzL [Mem-Tzadi-Lamed], which are Hochma, Daat, Bina. And he is called in Ezekiel "fair of branches and a shady grove," which is ZA, called the cedar of Lebanon, as is known.
